value.rationale: A complete family-wise conjugacy-class and irreducible character-degree classification of the natural Borel subgroup is a substantial finite-group invariant, uniform across all square-zero local rings including nonprincipal mixed-characteristic cases. The proof exposes a structural additive-dual stabilizer mechanism absent in the principal-ring orbit argument, and yields exact commuting probability and a nonzero large-embedding-dimension limit. Not an arbitrary numerical slice or textbook substitution.
